args.message: Bronze has the most customers and orders (100 customers, 2,493 orders, 24.93 orders per customer). Silver has 59 customers and 1,457 orders (about 24.69 each), and gold has 43 customers and 1,060 orders (about 24.65 each). Every customer is counted in their tier, and those without orders count as zero, so they lower the average.
